nominal_pose_source: Once-loaded offline baseline grip calibration and known pickup lift motor command; not current simulator truth or real perception
scope:
A small motor-only post-lift regrasp path from existing pickup to new grip.
Known offline calibration only. No simulator reset, live object pose or fixture.
Arm velocity/table geometry and sampled motor self-clearance are screened;
contact continuity is intentionally left to an actual physical rollout.

arm_audit.method: Quintic Cartesian path, continuous bounded G2 IK, motor commands only

initial_estimate_uncertainty: Nominal development path only; later paired evaluation must perturb initial estimates and actual pickup ends

ring_parking_audit.scope:
Park the optional ring across an estimated pickup/transfer motor trajectory.

Uses authored meshes and known planned joint/arm poses only. Changes no active
finger contact target, physical object, actuator or online policy input. Parking
is an initial known motor-plan choice, not an episode-internal state reset.

original_estimate.source: Labelled synthetic noisy onceinitial dimensional/slider observation, heldout runtime; no asset ID supplied to planner

offline_prior_update_scope: Onceprior from previouscontinuousattempt15.8s, no physicalstate/history writes or liveobjectfeedback; motorwrist/hand path and fixedpressureaxis unchanged

initial_geometry_estimate.source: Labelled synthetic noisy onceinitial dimensional/slider observation, heldout runtime; no asset ID supplied to planner

initial_geometry_adaptation_scope:
Common initial-estimate adaptation of actual pickup and postlift motor path.

No physical asset ID, current object state, contacts or force is read. This
retains known arm poses up to estimated table-height change and adapts each
hand waypoint to the same noisy dimensional/slider observation. Passing the
motor checks does not establish contact retention or successful operation.
